**Daily Market Summary · 15 November 2026**

**Alert**
• BTC rose back above $65,000 (about $65,376, from a $64,150 close yesterday). It follows an overnight fall to about $62,000; price is still under its 200-week average ($68,100).

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin about $65,376, down about 12.7% over 7 days and about 20% over 30 days.
• Headline: NEUTRAL, confidence LOW. The long-term trend still reads up, but the last few weeks are clearly weak.
• Fear & Greed is 10 (extreme fear).

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Bitcoin dropped to about $62,000 early today and bounced. An analyst quoted by PANews links it to concentrated selling in thin weekend trading.
• PANews reports miner MARA sold 13,597 bitcoin in six weeks and plans further sales; CoinGlass data (via PANews) shows about 12,600 BTC more flowed into exchanges than out over 7 days.

**Short-term outlook (next 1-7 days)**
• The mood is in deep fear and the coming days lean weak.
• Turns up: a close above $68,100 (200-week average), next $72,928 (200-day average).
• Sideways: $64,150 to $68,100; a normal week swings about $3,988.
• Turns down: a close below $64,150 (30-day low).
• Rally watch: drop window open since 13 November; a rally signal needs about $80,840, a fresh drop signal comes below about $68,863.
• Scheduled: next Fed meeting on 8 December.

**News that matters**
• MARA turns from holder to seller of its bitcoin (PANews): medium term, negative.
• Kava app exploit; Upbit paused KAVA transfers (PANews): short term, small negative.
• Kazakhstan plans tokenized government bonds in Q1 2027 (PANews): long term, small positive.

**Altcoins & themes**
• Broad weekend sell-off: ETH -4.6%, SOL -5.5%, DOGE -7.0% in 24h.
• New on Reku: Babylon (BABY) holds its founders call on 16 November, after Aave voted to accept native Bitcoin as collateral through Babylon (according to the project, also PANews).

**Bigger picture**
• Next month is mixed, leaning slightly down; it firms up only above $79,779 (50-day average). The 3-6 month picture still leans up, but needs a return above $72,928 (200-day average).

https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Digital marketing / Paid** — Hold trader-targeted spend and keep a reserve: a Rally watch drop window is open and Bitcoin is about 10% under its 200-day average. Apply the d30 ROI stop-loss on running campaigns and do not raise trader spend until a close back above $72,928. Lean new-user ads on trust and learning (Fear & Greed is 10), and keep rally creatives ready in case price reaches about $80,840.

**Social media & content** — Keep the normal rhythm with a calm, factual tone; Bitcoin is down about 12.7% in a week. Post a plain explainer on the overnight drop to about $62,000 (an analyst quoted by PANews links it to concentrated weekend selling) and a 'why big holders sell' piece using MARA's 13,597 bitcoin of sales (PANews). Add a security reminder using Kava's app exploit.

**CRM** — Reassure and educate existing holders; no promotional pressure while the drop window is open. Send a short note that Bitcoin is about 20% lower over the month and under its 200-week average, with an explainer link and no push to trade. Add an account-safety reminder (Kava exploit, Coinone support-desk data leak, both PANews) and keep the next onboarding journey ready for after a rally.

**SEO** — Pluang is covering the weekend drop heavily, so the High topics are: (1) why Bitcoin fell this weekend ('bitcoin turun ke level terendah tiga bulan di bawah 65000'): refresh 'why is Bitcoin down today' with plain reference levels; (2) US spot Bitcoin fund outflows (about $1.91 billion over seven sessions, per Pluang): publish or refresh a 'what are Bitcoin ETF flows' explainer; (3) XRP and Solana at multi-month lows: update those coin pages. Pintu's latest feed is mostly daily gold and stock price pages; Indodax could not be read today. Check each against Reku's pages. https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Altcoins** — The main theme is a broad weekend sell-off: ETH -4.6%, SOL -5.5%, DOGE -7.0% in 24h, and BIT's analyst says the market has lost about $800 billion since early October (PANews). Large holders are on both sides: MARA, a B2C2-linked address (LINK) and Forward (SOL) moved or sold coins, while wallets linked to Erik Voorhees bought about $97 million of ETH (PANews). New on Reku: Babylon (BABY) holds its founders call on 16 November, and Midnight (NIGHT) is up about 22% in 7 days after its Ledger 9 upgrade (PANews), though no single reason is given for this week's move; PONS is down about 31% in 7 days despite a 33% supply burn, according to the project.
